title: Vignette 2026-10-30: research is a tree of documents that gets deeper

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30: "So, we have a few things here,.

The exploration of flow and decisions should not be just vignettes. 

SRS is designed to manage data in a structured way. Where we have a research area it should be structured as a tree of documents that get deeper. 

As a human or agent I should be able to find a top level introduction and then drill down into parts. 


Our flow work has identified a set of possible domains, these exist as domains, but they should also be laid out in a way that would allow me to navigate... From high level overview down to specific details.

This structuring of data should be part of the skill we teach. It's the human readable work we have just been doing."
